borrow(address,uint256,uint256,uint16,ad.details: Requires credit delegation from `onBehalfOf` to this contract on the variable debt token.

assetToUsdc(address,uint256).notice: Converts `amount` of `asset` into USDC units (6 decimals) using Aave oracle.

borrow(address,uint256,uint256,uint16,ad.notice: Borrows `amount` of `asset` onto `onBehalfOf` and forwards tokens to `recipient`.

getReserveTokens(address).notice: Returns aToken / debt token addresses for a reserve.

repay(address,uint256,uint256,address).notice: Repays debt for `onBehalfOf`, pulling repayment tokens from the caller.

snapshot(address,address,address,address.notice: Builds a USD/USDC mark-to-market snapshot for an Aave account.

supply(address,uint256,address,uint16).notice: Supplies `amount` of `asset` to Aave; aTokens are minted to `onBehalfOf`.

withdraw(address,uint256,address).notice: Withdraws underlying using aTokens already held by this manager.
